metric.name: totalConnections
metric.description: Total number of connections in the pool

metric.name: activeConnections
metric.description: Number of connections that are currently in use

metric.name: idleConnections
metric.description: Number of connections that are currently idle

metric.name: threadsAwaitingConnection
metric.description: Number of threads waiting for a connection

metric.name: maxConnections
metric.description: Maximum number of connections allowed in the pool

metric.name: threadPinningEvents
metric.description: Number of times a virtual thread was pinned to a platform thread during database operations

metric.name: pinningDuration
metric.description: Duration of thread pinning events

metric.name: virtualThreadCount
metric.description: Number of virtual threads currently using connections

metric.name: platformThreadCount
metric.description: Number of platform threads currently using connections

metric.name: threadTypeRatio
metric.description: Ratio of virtual to platform threads using connections

metric.name: connectionAcquisitionTime
metric.description: Time taken to acquire a connection from the pool

metric.name: connectionAcquisitionTimeouts
metric.description: Number of timeouts when attempting to acquire a connection

metric.name: connectionCreationTime
metric.description: Time taken to create a new connection

metric.name: connectionBorrowRate
metric.description: Rate at which connections are borrowed from the pool

metric.name: connectionReturnRate
metric.description: Rate at which connections are returned to the pool

metric.name: connectionUsageTime
metric.description: Time a connection is used before being returned to the pool

metric.name: connectionIdleTime
metric.description: Time a connection remains idle in the pool

metric.name: connectionLifetime
metric.description: Total lifetime of a connection

metric.name: statementExecutionTime
metric.description: Time taken to execute SQL statements

metric.name: transactionTime
metric.description: Time taken to complete a transaction

metric.name: transactionBoundaryTransitions
metric.description: Number of transaction boundary transitions in Virtual Thread context

metric.name: transactionCommitTime
metric.description: Time taken to commit a transaction in Virtual Thread context

metric.name: transactionRollbackTime
metric.description: Time taken to rollback a transaction in Virtual Thread context

metric.name: transactionBoundaryPinningEvents
metric.description: Number of thread pinning events during transaction boundaries

metric.name: connectionFailures
metric.description: Number of connection failures

metric.name: connectionLeakDetections
metric.description: Number of connection leaks detected

metric.name: connectionValidationFailures
metric.description: Number of connection validation failures

metric.name: deadlockDetections
metric.description: Number of deadlocks detected

metric.name: connectionResetCount
metric.description: Number of times connections had to be reset

metric.name: preparedStatementCacheHitRatio
metric.description: Hit ratio of the prepared statement cache

metric.name: preparedStatementCacheSize
metric.description: Current size of the prepared statement cache

metric.name: serverRoundtripTime
metric.description: Time taken for a round trip to the PostgreSQL server

metric.name: pgStatementExecutionTime
metric.description: Time taken to execute PostgreSQL statements

metric.name: pgConnectionSetupTime
metric.description: Time taken to set up a PostgreSQL connection

metric.name: mountedOperations
metric.description: Number of operations that caused a virtual thread to mount to a carrier thread

metric.name: unmountedOperations
metric.description: Number of operations that allowed a virtual thread to unmount from a carrier thread

metric.name: continuationCount
metric.description: Number of continuations (yield points) in virtual threads

metric.name: yieldCount
metric.description: Number of times virtual threads yielded execution

metric.name: parkCount
metric.description: Number of times virtual threads parked

health-check.name: connection-pool-size
health-check.description: Verifies that the connection pool size is within acceptable limits

health-check.name: connection-liveness
health-check.description: Verifies that connections in the pool are alive and usable

health-check.name: thread-pinning-rate
health-check.description: Monitors the rate of thread pinning events to detect potential issues

health-check.name: connection-acquisition-time
health-check.description: Monitors connection acquisition time to detect performance issues

health-check.name: virtual-thread-compatibility
health-check.description: Verifies that the PostgreSQL driver is compatible with Virtual Threads
